column6: Indirectly attested in the form of (LÚ)kuu̯an- 'hound-man'. We have included *kuu̯an- / kun- as the best currently-known potential candidate based on parallel vocabulary (cf. Melchert 1989, EDHIL s.v.), while at the same time we acknowledge that due to the fragmentary attestation of Hittite a more suitable target lexeme may also have existed.
Native script form ti-it-ti-te-et is abl.-instr., cf. Tischler TEG T p.393.
Cf. HW² K 8-12 s.v. gaga-, UZU qaqa- 'Zahn' for attestations and discussion.
Cf. CHD L-N 72 for attestations and discussion.
